svg.title: SOT switching regimes (Type-z PMA vs Type-y in-plane) and spin-diffusion efficiency scaling
svg.desc: Two-panel figure comparing (a) Type-z perpendicular switching with symmetry-breaking assist field B_x and computed macrospin LLG+SOT hysteresis loops versus field-free Type-y in-plane collinear anti-damping switching, and (b) analytical spin-diffusion thickness scaling xi_DL(t_HM) = T_int theta_SH [1 - sech(t_HM / lambda_sf)] relative to bulk theta_SH.

svg.text: Illustrative parameters: λsf = 1.1 nm, θSH = 0.20, Tint = 0.66 (Nguyen et al. 2016).
Calibrate (ξDL, ξFL) per stack for local SOT; use M1/M2 to predict thickness & backflow.
